comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclose specific unconditional purchase commitments and capital expenditure obligations with defined amounts and time horizons. AMD reports $5.0 billion in unconditional purchase commitments, primarily for wafers and substrates, with $4.5 billion due in fiscal year 2025 (amd_2024_7_P060_S001). Similarly, Intel discloses substantial capital expenditure commitments ($14.0 billion for 2025 and $6.0 billion long-term) and other purchase obligations ($2.1 billion for 2025 and $4.9 billion long-term) as of December 28, 2024 (intc_2024_7_P094_S002, intc_2024_7_P094_S003). While AMD focuses its disclosed commitment total on wafer/substrate purchases and licenses, Intel separates capital expenditures from other purchase obligations, reflecting their respective manufacturing models, but both provide granular breakdowns by fiscal year.

sentences.text: As of December 28, 2024, we had unconditional purchase commitments of approximately $5.0 billion, of which $4.5 billion are in fiscal year 2025.

Our contractual obligations and purchase commitments relate primarily to our obligations to purchase wafers and substrates from third parties and future payments related to certain software and technology licenses and IP licenses.
As of December 28, 2024, we had commitments for capital expenditures of $14.0 billion for 2025 and had $6.0 billion in capital expenditures committed in the long term.

As of December 28, 2024, other purchase obligations and commitments in 2025 under our binding commitments for purchases of goods and services were $2.1 billion, with an additional $4.9 billion committed in the long term.

sentences.text: As of December 28, 2024, we had unconditional purchase commitments of approximately $5.0 billion, of which $4.5 billion are in fiscal year 2025.

Our contractual obligations and purchase commitments relate primarily to our obligations to purchase wafers and substrates from third parties and future payments related to certain software and technology licenses and IP licenses.

• Our purchase obligations at September 29, 2024, which primarily relate to purchase commitments with certain suppliers of our integrated circuit products, including those under multi-year capacity commitments, totaled $12.8 billion, of which, $9.6 billion is expected to be paid in the next 12 months.
